title: Throat of the Saw
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A roaring subtractive supersaw lead screaming in the high register, thickened by detuned octave copies and hard drive. A slow 32-cycle ladder-filter journey opens it from a muffled growl into a full screaming roar while vibrato, FM bite and stereo width breathe underneath.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<f3 [f3 c4] ab3 <eb4 g4>>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .add(note("0,0.07,-0.07"))
    .fm(sine.slow(21).range(0.5, 4)).fmh("<1 2 1.5>/8")
    .vib("<5 7 9>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(380, 7200)).resonance(sine.slow(24).range(8, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 3 4>/4").lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.22).lpsustain(0.5)
    .attack(0.006).decay(0.18).sustain(0.7).release(0.08)
    .shape(sine.slow(16).range(0.2, 0.55)).distort(0.4)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.18, 0.82))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.5))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).pan(0.75))
    .jux(rev)
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.crush(7))
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.55").room(0.25)
    .gain(0.85)
)
